description: This file defines a utility function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes raw cost records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts, organizing data by agent name and secondary grouping (like environment or cost category). It handles sorting, categorization, and zero-filling to ensure consistent grouped bar chart data.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, grouping by agent and an optional secondary dimension (environment or cost category), with zero-filled categories for consistency.
